rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price ($15.46) trades below both session VWAP and the 9-EMA ($15.52) after opening at the day's high ($16.03) and gapping down 2.49% on 5.6x relative volume, with a risk-off tape (SPY -0.25%, VIXY +1.19%) supporting continued weakness. The last five 1-minute bars show low-volume consolidation, not a reversal (no VWAP reclaim or buying thrust), so there is no stronger evidence to flip long, and the remaining distance to take-profit (~0.97%) still exceeds the risk to the $15.57 invalidation (~0.71%). Momentum has stalled since entry, which caps conviction, but it does not justify paying the spread and commissions to close a working position.
